newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AHOLD AIMS EXPANSION INTO S.AMERICA.
newsitem.headline: AHOLD AIMS EXPANSION INTO S.AMERICA.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Thursday it was looking for further expansion possibilities in southern America as it considered the times of superinflation in the region to be over.

"We have good hope super inflation is a thing of the past (in southern America). This has a positive effect on the population's purchasing power," Fritz Ahlqvist, member of the Board told a press conference.
He said Ahold was not only interested in new partners or expansion possibilities within Brasil, but also looked at other countries.
"Argentina and Chile are certainly worth taking a closer look at," he said.
Ahlqvist said Ahold was actively looking for opportunities in the region, but could not give an indication of the date the supermarkets group would take its first steps into one of those countries.
"Its a matter a targeted searching and targeted finding. It all depends on what we find over there," he said.
Chairman Cees van der Hoeven said Ahold intended to make long-lasting agreements with its partners.
